name: GB-Sol GBS Custom 350W
notes: Technology: standard (non half-cut) crystalline silicon cells, 84-cell, monofacial with a single 4mm low-iron toughened front glass - thicker than the 3.2mm used on most panels in this database. Made in Pontypridd, South Wales, since 1994; GB-Sol don't sell a catalogue of wattage bins like the Tier-1 manufacturers - this 350W laminate is their standard framed/BIPV module, built to order for their own RIS in-roof and PV Slate systems as well as conventional mounting. Pros: MCS-accredited and genuinely UK-manufactured, with a structural glass build proven since 1994 - the RIS in-roof system it's designed for is a distinct, established UK alternative to Viridian's Clearline Fusion for conservation-area and listed-building projects where standard on-roof racking isn't acceptable. Cons: older cell technology than current Tier-1 panels, with a correspondingly steep -0.42%/degC Pmax temperature coefficient; the published datasheet doesn't state a weight, max series fuse, max system voltage, or list price - GB-Sol sell bespoke to project specification rather than off-the-shelf, so get a full spec and quote directly rather than assuming these.
